runs.name: Diploma PLC
runs.entry: The second name on the operator's sheet with no SEC filings. Price **7,785p (GBP 77.85)** per ordinary share (DPLM.L, London, close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged; the OTC ADR DPMAY closed USD 25.83 the same day, ratio about four ADRs to one share implied from the two quotes, not read from a depositary document, so no per-ADR figure) x **134,236,030 shares** (134,317,398 in issue, no treasury, Total Voting Rights announcement of 2025-12-01, less 81,368 held by the Employee Benefit Trust, AR2025 parent note F; `cover_shares.py` and `run.py` returned not an SEC filer) = cap **GBP 10,450M**; sovereign **6.05%** (Bank of England fitted nominal curve, 30-year spot, 2026-10-08; the Bank, not the Debt Management Office). Primary documents the company's own Annual Reports FY2016 to FY2025 (AR2025 approved 2025-11-18), Half Year Results 2026 (2026-05-19), the trading updates of 2026-01-14 and 2026-03-18 and the Q3 call transcript of 2026-07-16, documents and dates recorded in place of accessions; FY2025 free cash flow GBP 247.2M cross-checked to note 29.4, net debt GBP 299.4M to the balance sheet. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from AR2025's business model, Sector reviews, financial review, principal risks and remuneration report, as the overnight brief directs. Q1 IN (a value-add distributor of low-cost critical parts in three Sectors; key variables gross margin, organic volume, what acquisitions earn). Q2 IN (Controls decides at 55.6% of FY2021-FY2025 Sector profit, 55.1% statutory; margin 14.6% to 21.1% FY2016-FY2021, 30.0% in FY2025; gross margin held through the 2021-2023 inflation; the FY2023-FY2026 margin step not credited, the filer's own "favourable market conditions" and the CEO's Peerless margin "easing"; re-look condition the first fiscal year in which Controls' or Peerless's revenue falls). Q3 weighs for. Q4 accounts IN, habits against (adjusted figures exclude deal costs that recur every year; FY2026 guidance raised three times; ten balance sheets FY2016-FY2025: goodwill and acquisition intangibles GBP 170M to 1,043M, tangible equity negative since FY2021, GBP 421M of shares placed, net cash GBP 207M to net debt GBP 299M-420M, mostly long fixed-rate notes). Q5 IN on integrity (bad news told; the CFO removed in August 2025 over personal conduct). Q6 Part A for narrowly (retention test met FY2021-FY2025; no buybacks; cash placings at 1,711p in 2020 and 2,525p in 2023, both above today's range; no all-stock deal), Part B against (pay on adjusted EPS growth and TSR). **Q7 OUT on the floor:** owner cash (operating cash less net capital spending, lease principal and stock pay) FY2021-FY2025 average GBP 165.2M before interest (150.7 equity-only), a 1.5% yield on the business at the price, against acquisitions of GBP 232.6M a year deducted with total growth; growth 23.9% shown, cut by specific (f) to the 6.05% discount rate; the growth case falls below the no-growth case (purchases cost more than the growth they buy). Net debt used GBP 513.9M (31 March 2026 plus post-period deals and CDM, c.GBP 125M, completed by July 2026). Range **GBP 11.50-16.52** all-equity (equity-only 12.46-18.56), literal window FY2021-FY2025; organic pair top GBP 40.45 beside; the most generous variant (23.9% uncut) earns about 6.1% at the price. Fair **GBP 4.53** all-equity (7.00 equity-only; organic pair 14.59 beside). Q8 to Q12 not reached. Competitors: the reports name no rival in ten years; the analyst chose WESCO, Graybar and Applied Industrial (SEC filers, margins from SEC data feeds, not read in filed statements), operating margins 2.5% to 11% against Diploma's 13% to 18.6%; no public aerospace-fastener distributor to set against Peerless. Citations: the analyst's check 76 ids, 35 fragments clean; the dispatcher's script (`fold_cite_check.py`) 76 ids present, 33 fragments, 0 slips. check_framework PASS. Analyst's gaps for the operator: (1) specific (f)'s cut forces growth to the discount rate inside the ten years, against the sentence before it that makes the shown rate the cap inside the ten years (variants shown, box unchanged); (2) the growth case for a serial acquirer whose purchases exceed its owner cash falls below the no-growth case; (3) Q2's uncredited margin step against Q7's window that carries the step's peak year; (4) no named rivals, choice the analyst's; (5) net debt for a deal closed after the filing, where the all-equity rule and specific (c) overlap; (6) the template's accession wording for a non-SEC name. Not obtained: the ADR ratio, the DMO gilt series, post-purchase earnings of each acquisition.
runs.narr: Q7 OUT on the floor at 7,785p (London): range GBP 11.50-16.52 all-equity, fair GBP 4.53; owner cash GBP 165.2M a year is a 1.5% yield at the price, and the GBP 232.6M a year of acquisitions cost more than the growth they buy. Q1 and Q2 IN on Controls (cable, aerospace and specialty fasteners), its jump to a 30% margin not credited; Q4 habits and Q6 Part B against on adjusted figures that leave out recurring deal costs and pay on adjusted EPS. The fold tool arms alerts in USD only, so the sterling alert was set by hand on DPLM.L in pence.
